name: Tagger
author: brodgar
description: Example addon: what is DRAWN at a game object, and what is already on it -- gob:overlay() as a collection of screen-space labels and draws, beside the game's own overlays and whatever you stood at that gob with hafen.vr(), all in one read. ':tagger' toggles player labels; 'pin', 'read' and 'watch' do the rest.
